newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea steps in, sells dlrs at 877.00 won.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea steps in, sells dlrs at 877.00 won.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea intervened in the interbank market in late afternoon trading on Monday, selling dollars at around 877.00 to support the won, dealers said.
But the bank denied the action, as it routinely does.
The Bank of Korea came in 20 minutes before the closing to stop the won's steep decline against the dollar, traders said.
Demand for the dollar has been rising in line with increasing import deals and speculative buying, they said.
Soon after the intervention, the won rebounded to 875.00.
